Description: web3lane Eve HTTPS ingress - isolated CloudFront VPC origin for SSE; no custom domain and no paid API changes.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: CloudFront HTTPS -> VPC origin -> existing internal ALB -> Nginx -> loopback Eve container
must: Keep paid API Gateway routes and their load-balancer access unchanged.
Do not deploy until the selected Bedrock model can complete a live authenticated agent turn.

InternalLoadBalancerArn.Description: ARN of the existing internal ALB. Deploy only after it is confirmed eligible for a CloudFront VPC origin.

InternalLoadBalancerDnsName.Description: DNS name of the existing internal ALB.

InternalLoadBalancerSecurityGroupId.Description: Security group attached to the internal ALB.

CloudFrontOriginPrefixListId.Description: Regional ID of the AWS-managed com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Permits CloudFront VPC-origin traffic without altering the existing API Gateway VPC-link rule.
must: Use the regional AWS-managed CloudFront origin-facing prefix list.
Do not replace or broaden the paid API security-group ingress.

Properties.Description: CloudFront VPC origin traffic to Eve ingress

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keeps the Eve origin private while CloudFront provides the public HTTPS endpoint.
must: The referenced ALB must satisfy current CloudFront VPC-origin subnet requirements.
Do not move the paid API ALB to make this resource work.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Prevents cached workflow and server-sent event responses.

CachePolicyConfig.Comment: Never cache Eve workflow or SSE responses.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Preserves Eve authentication, session, and workflow request data at the private origin.
must: Forward Authorization without including the viewer Host header.

OriginRequestPolicyConfig.Comment: Forward Eve auth, session, and workflow request data; CloudFront supplies the origin Host header.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Prevents the public CloudFront hostname from reaching paid-service paths on the shared ALB.

FunctionConfig.Comment: Allow only Eve and workflow discovery paths through the public distribution.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Provides a standalone cloudfront.net HTTPS endpoint for Eve without a custom domain.
must: Keep CloudFront response completion timeout unset for long-lived SSE.
Do not add paid API paths or behaviors to this distribution.

DistributionConfig.Comment: Public HTTPS Eve agent ingress. The generated cloudfront.net hostname is the endpoint.

AgentHttpsUrl.Description: Set QA_AGENT_URL to this URL after health, authenticated streaming, reconnect, and restart recovery checks pass.
